summary: Retested SortTh scoping crash fix on /crm. Injected valid JWT into localStorage (UI login was blocked by reCAPTCHA verification failure in automation context — unrelated to this fix). Navigated to Customer CRM via nav-crm. Verified CRM page mounts without React error overlay and no 'SortTh is not defined' runtime error. All 4 tabs render (tab-targets, tab-outstanding, tab-followups, tab-behavior). Default Targets tab displays all 6 sortable headers (sort-crm-customer_name, sort-crm-previous_fy_sales, sort-crm-target_amount, sort-crm-achieved, sort-crm-achievement_percentage, sort-crm-remaining) with working ↓/↑ arrow indicators (Customer Name already showing ↓ indicator on first render confirming SortTh + sortField state wired correctly). Screenshot confirms Targets tab renders 12+ customer rows cleanly. SortTh crash fix VERIFIED.

integration_issues.issue: Browser-based login returns 200 with {success:false, error:'CAPTCHA verification failed. Please try again.'} because grecaptcha.execute times out in headless automation. Direct curl login (no captcha_token field) succeeds. Not part of current task but blocks automated UI flows.

issues: React hydration warning: <span> rendered inside <option> in /app/frontend/src/components/AppNavbar.js line 81 — '<option>' cannot have '<span>' child. Causes console hydration error on every page load.

action_items: (Out of scope for this iteration, FYI) Fix fy-selector AppNavbar.js:81 — remove nested <span> inside <option> to clear hydration warning.
(Out of scope) Investigate why UI login requires captcha_token while curl without captcha_token works — captcha verification logic may reject empty-string token but accept missing field.
